items.title: Our Websites Might Get Weird
items.summary: Howdy all, Now that we’ve migrated to Route 53 (see other thread for that), Ilia is enabling Cloudfront on our website and new software repositories (all but forum and old software.virtualmin.com). This might break www.virtualmin.com and the new download.virtualmin.com websites. If it breaks, we probably already know about it, and are working on a fix. But, I figured I’d post about it, just in case. Cheers, Joe

items.title: We're messing with DNS, something might break
items.summary: Howdy all, Just a heads up. Ilia and I are messing around with DNS today, migrating to Route 53. Theoretically, we’re experts and we know what we’re doing, but realistically, we may have missed something and something will break. So, if anything goes offline, it’s DNS and we’ll probably fix it quickly. Since we’re migrating all zones to Route 53, all services have the potential to break. I doubt any of the obvious things will go wrong, but we might have to fight with email-related records. If...
